notes.title: 📰 Thank you for the playtest, and check out what's next!
notes.content:
🙏 Fellow forgers - Thank you!

We're super glad so many of you joined us during our recent playtest session, and we'd love to give you a sneak peek at what's coming.

A lot of you also filled out our survey and submitted your ideas and opinions. Those will really help us out as we proceed with working on the game and its mechanics. Thank you!
Let's look at a couple of fun facts from the feedback you provided:

96% of you didn't encounter any serious technical problems with the game during the playtest - awesome to hear!

17% of you failed at some point during the playtest story - it's okay, we never said forging is gonna be a piece of cake!

We asked you to rate your experience with Forgery Craft - the average rating turned out to be 4.29!

65% of you decided to leave us some really detailed feedback about mechanics and dialogues - you guys are awesome!

Once again, thank you so much for filling out our survey and submitting your ideas and opinions. Those will really help us out as we proceed with working on the game and its mechanics.


🔮 What happens next?

We're currently making sure to implement all the feedback we've gathered into our future development steps. We will continue pushing Forgery Craft forward as usual, and we're planning to keep you in the loop a bit more than before!

First of all, you can expect some interesting sneak peeks showing up on Discord every now and then. 
Right now, on our Discord server, we're also running a little community poll to collect some feedback regarding camera controls. We'd love to know your opinion on that matter!

Option A: You're docked onto a document when you click on it with the tool:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/6f1a3bfb44b4343e8ee599eea98d34bacf8f12b4.gif

Option B: You can move around the desk with the tool and edit any document you hover over:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/5bf4b23c0a8c7577e63bbb17f3944ecf03793fb2.gif

Make sure to hop in for more info, and to cast your vote:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/dbe1646f520261203b91fd62cef6b76f40643b0c.jpg

Here on Steam, we'll also be letting you know how things are going, but in the form of less frequent and more info-packed Steam announcements. Keep in mind that adding Forgery Craft to your wishlist is one of the best ways to keep yourself informed regarding our progress, as well as exclusive community events such as the recent playtest session.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1540720/Forgery_Craft/


Big kudos for your lovely support, forgers! See you next time!

notes.title: Behind the curtain: cutting mechanic trivia
notes.content:
Greetings, adepts of the forgery art![hr][/hr]
Did you know that in 1794, a certain cunning forger cut off a piece of an authentic Elizabethan or Jacobean parchment deed and then signed it with William Shakespeare’s signature, making it a valuable piece for collectors? This is just one incident in the case of a 'Shakespeare cache’—a treasure trove filled with the lost works and documents of the greatest dramatist himself. It was allegedly found by a British writer (and lpater a famous forger of Shakespeare's works), William Henry Ireland. Were they authentic? Of course not. That's why we are telling you about them!

And why do we talk about cutting stuff again? Because we improved the cutting mechanic!




Cutting at any angle![hr][/hr]
Cutting only at right angles seems to be an unnecessary restriction on the player's creativity. We improved the system to support cutting at any angle, and what's more, it even allows you to cut through pieces glued on top of each other! But please, mind your fingers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/cf19fd5c7efecb63b733598d80ff577724270a43.gif



Technique used? Mixed![hr][/hr]
What is a forger who only cuts out or signs? In our game, to prevent the forgery from backfiring, players must skillfully select the tools needed to achieve the desired effect. Mix and match until you've fooled them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/16fdca0a57343dfd6568380ed2b0217e0f08475c.gif



To join our Discord, please click the image below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/391f9db3f243ea14ee312e82b23a886d93e8ec2d.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1540720/Forgery_Craft/

[hr][/hr]
Check your attic for the famous writer's “lost” notes. Toodle-oo!
– Forgery Craft Team

notes.title: Mechanics showcase: cutting stuff
notes.content:
Hello fellow forgers!
Since releasing the trailer, we've been working hard on new mechanics for Forgery Craft, which can be useful when you need to swap some photos around or fiddle with documents. It's now time to present the results: welcome the cutting mechanic! 



With surgical precision[hr][/hr]
Use a blade to precisely cut off any unwanted part from a document. Maybe you need a quick identity change? Cut yourself out from a family portrait and put in a "borrowed" ID. Or simply gather a collection of letters from newspapers. You know well that they may come in handy if someone gets under your skin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44743432/f42c8afdb0e702d35adbc731b5b6945b6be8a0dd.gif



We're on Discord![hr][/hr]
Want some exclusive insights into our game's development? Look no further - join our Discord server! Exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, giving you glimpses of our creative process. Your input is invaluable, and we actively seek your feedback to decide how to shape our game!
